title: The headless-runner guards and the KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER marker are removed from the tools
goal: Only the autopilot set KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER, so its guards are dead: remove the marker (bl_intake.HEADLESS_ENV and every reader of it) and the guard code it switches on from kb_hook.py (headless_guard and its PreToolUse wiring in .claude/settings.json), bl_land.py, kg_sync.py (headless target refusal), kbpublic.py, querylog.py (launch does nothing headless), backlog.py, bl_intake.py, kbdecide.py and conftest.py, and the tests that exist only for them (test_headless_guard.py, test_headless_hooks.py, test_headless_start_guarded.py, test_sync_headless.py, test_kbpublic_hook_env.py, test_backlog_headless_operator.py, test_bl_authority_guards.py, test_bl_authority_trust.py, test_docs_headless_statements.py), each removed test id listed in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt with the reason 'autopilot retired'. Keep the repro rule that an open item's repro runs without a shell (test_open_repros_run_headless) and every interactive behaviour. Nothing may be added to .claude/settings.json. After it, git grep -n KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER finds nothing in _tools, .claude or kb/_self. Interactive session; kb_hook.py, kbpublic.py and the settings are agents-rule files.
notes: The PreToolUse wiring runs _tools/kb_hook.py generically, so removing headless_guard needs no settings edit; a settings edit is the operator's: if a test pin forces one, stop and file a bug. Keep test_open_repros_run_headless and all interactive behaviour. Still present: kb_hook.headless_guard and HEADLESS_ENV, kg_sync.headless_target_refusal, kbpublic.HEADLESS_ENV, bl_intake HEADLESS_ENV and check_program_refusal, the querylog launch headless branch. Traps: tests copy fixed tool lists into temp repos and break when a module goes (TOOL_FILES in test_backlog_research.py, KS_TOOLS in test_bl_check.py, copied_tools in test_kbdecide.py, hand lists in test_backlog.py, test_backlog_authority.py, test_bl_stall.py, test_kblog.py): git grep each removed module over _tools/test_*.py before landing. A literal deleted path in an open item's touches is a check error (use globs); done refuses a changed file outside touches (widen on the work branch); an item check `selfdoc.py stale` fails on any stale doc (read it, name it in Self-Reviewed). Use focused `-n 1` test runs; land in the background with the longest timeout; no writes in the clone during land or sync; rm -rf is denied; trailer order Co-Authored-By, Self-Reviewed, KB-Work. The Windows/Intune Autopilot product is never touched (kb/public/**, product lists in README.md, plugin.json, kb-lookup skill, .gitattributes csdl lines, _tools/tests_allowlist.txt).
